delta_basis: User added owner acceptance and explicit approval before invitations or access grants.

verdict.rationale: Direct IAP supports the required Google-account allowlist, but OAuth configuration, verified application identity and deployed acceptance remain unresolved. winner not established: P1 has no comparative evidence and retains unknowns. Suitability is not a deployment security pass; owner acceptance and explicit approval must precede invitations or access grants.
verdict.separating_test: Run the same app through direct IAP and load-balancer IAP with one allowlisted and one non-allowlisted Google account. Compare signed-out and denied-user access, Gradio queue/stream behavior, run.app bypass and forged identity headers; record setup changes and results.
